executiveSummary: Apple is preparing for a busy product release cycle, with multiple new devices and updates on the horizon. The company is also facing supply chain issues and potential pricing changes. Meanwhile, AI and ML developments are being discussed in various industries.

takeaways.title: AI/ML developments
takeaways.description: Anthropic is committing 5% of its shares to a 'public benefit fund', highlighting the growing focus on AI and ML in various industries, as discussed in TechCrunch article 6.

takeaways.title: Supply chain issues
takeaways.description: Apple is reportedly facing supply chain issues, with MacRumors article 21 mentioning that iPhone Duo walk-in purchases might be challenging due to manufacturing challenges.

takeaways.title: Pricing changes
takeaways.description: Tello Mobile is offering affordable plans, with 9to5Mac article 4 mentioning that switching to Tello Mobile can bring the cost of a plan down to as little as $5 a month.

worthWatching: The development of SteamOS handheld, a competitor to the Steam Deck OLED, which runs identical software but ships in a different design with two-stage triggers, bigger screen, and double the RAM and storage, as discussed in The Verge article 17.
The potential release of Apple's first touchscreen MacBook, which could bring a new user interface to the Mac notebook lineup, as discussed in 9to5Mac article 19.
engineeringPerspective: The implementation of AI-powered features in various devices, such as the iPhone Duo, which may require significant software development and optimization, as discussed in 9to5Mac article 2.
The use of AI and ML in robotics, such as the SteamOS handheld, which could have implications for robotics and automation, as discussed in The Verge article 17.
